To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the electromagnetic parameters and high-frequency absorbing properties of Fe3O4 can be tuned by combining reduced graphene oxide (rGO).

the electromagnetic properties of Fe3O4 and graphene composites can be adjusted by changing the content of graphene, and the optimal absorbing performance can be achieved at 10.8 GHz with a thickness of only 1.7 mm.
the anisotropic Fe 3 O 4 /graphene nanocomposites exhibit excellent electromagnetic wave absorption performance in a broad frequency range.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of high-efficient absorbing materials and provides a new way for the development and application of electromagnetic absorber materials.
the design, synthesis, and characterization of a series of Fe3O4/RGO composites, which are expected to be promising candidates as lightweight high-efficiency microwave absorbers.
the preparation and electromagnetic property of anisotropic magnetic composites, and provides a new idea for the preparation and application of magnetic composites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the anisotropic FeO4/RGO nanocomposite with the proper amount of RGO is a good candidate for high-frequency absorption.
the anisotropic Fe 3O 4 nanoparticle and its graphene composites are promising high-frequency absorbers with lightweight, high efficiency, broad bandwidth and low cost.
the anisotropic FeO nanoparticles and its graphene composites are promising candidates for high-efficient electromagnetic absorbing materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the high-efficient electromagnetic absorption can be realized by combining anisotropic magnetic nanoparticles and graphene.

the anisotropic Fe 3O 4/graphene nanoscale absorbers with excellent electromagnetic properties can be fabricated by a simple and low-cost chemical method, which can be expected to be used for electromagnetic interference shielding in the future.
the anisotropic magnetic nanoparticles and their composites with graphene are promising candidates for high-frequency absorbers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of RGO to Fe3O 4 can effectively improve the high-frequency absorption properties of the composite.
it can be used for the design of high-efficient electromagnetic wave absorbing materials.
the anisotropic Fe2O3/graphene composites can be a potential candidate in the application of electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding and absorbing.
